scenario.name: Original conditions
scenario.description: English labels, standard timing, and the declared appointment availability.

limitations: Automated keyboard and DOM evidence only; actual screen-reader output is not recorded.
No consenting participant trial or independent specialist review has been completed.
Authored development fixtures share component ancestry; these scenarios are not a held-out benchmark.
Scoped component adapter only. Arbitrary repository builds require a separate isolated worker.

checks.label: Keep required information required
checks.expected: Empty required name or date is rejected; no appointment is stored.
checks.actual: Service returned 422/422; required-field error visible; stored appointment: none.

checks.label: Protect unavailable appointments
checks.expected: An unavailable date is rejected by the independent service.
checks.actual: Saving 2026-11-20 returned 422; no booking was created.

checks.label: Reach the appointment control
checks.expected: Tab reaches a named appointment control.

checks.label: Leave the picker with Escape
checks.expected: Opening does not commit a date; Escape closes the picker, preserves the pre-open value, and returns focus.
checks.actual: Opening preserved the value; picker closed; focus returned to trigger; pre-open value preserved.

checks.label: Choose a date with the keyboard
checks.expected: Opening preserves the prior value; actual keyboard activation commits the intended available date, 2026-11-16.

checks.label: Keep a place in the journey
checks.expected: After choosing a date, focus returns to its appointment trigger.
checks.actual: The trigger is the actual activeElement after selection.

checks.label: Expose recovery messages
checks.expected: Required and late validation errors expose alert/live-region semantics.
checks.actual: The observed validation messages had alert semantics. Screen-reader speech has not been recorded.

checks.label: Store the date that was chosen
checks.expected: The protected backend record matches the requested available date, name, and source digest.
checks.actual: Saved 2026-11-16 for Alex Morgan; record c8f9a228-9c57-434f-9b08-30ec9d83e492; all outcome fields match.

checks.label: Arrive at the confirmation
checks.expected: After a real successful save, focus lands on the confirmation heading.
checks.actual: The confirmation heading is the actual activeElement.
